findings.replacement: Tin nhắn về tài nguyên này
findings.why: English is a noun phrase ("Message about this asset") naming the composer field; «Nhắn về …» is a verb phrase (imperative "Message about…"). It works as a field prompt, but the noun form matches the sidecar ("a fragment") and sibling labels.

Core vi splits the word: conversation tags are «nhãn» (relay.chrome.row.tags, tui.tags.*), asset-library tags are «thẻ» (wire.errors.desktop.library_tag_*). Mobile Library is the asset surface, so «thẻ» is the right choice; no mobile vi string uses either word outside library. Recorded so a later reader does not "fix" it to «nhãn».
